phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, own posture unknown-oriented with moderate production and heavy tech investment; opponent appears ground-oriented with light defense and heavy economy.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when more enemy units are scouted or when transitioning to midgame.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize ground army strength, economy growth, and tech progression; maintain production and defense.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground forces while increasing economy and continuing technology development.
phase_policies.title: Early Tech/Economy Foundation
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a single tech path without scouting, neglecting defense against possible aggression.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame, own posture ground-oriented with heavy production and tech; opponent also ground-oriented with heavy production and possible pressure.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when midgame approaches or if enemy composition shifts.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain ground army path, expand economy and bases, continue tech; keep production steady.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground forces, increase economy and expansions, and maintain technology development.
phase_policies.title: Ground Macro Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not make drastic changes to army composition or tech without information, overcommitting to a countered path.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, both sides have heavy ground-oriented macro postures with heavy production and tech; own army includes Marines, Marauders, Medivacs.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when enemy air presence becomes clearer or when pushing for a decisive engagement.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Add air units and tech, keep ground forces strong, expand economy; maintain production.
phase_policies.target: Increase air presence and technology while continuing to strengthen ground forces and economy.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Army Consolidation
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect ground army strength or economy while transitioning to air.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame, own posture ground-oriented with heavy production and tech, moderate air presence; opponent ground-oriented with heavy defense.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when enemy anti-air capabilities are assessed.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Transition to air, expand economy and tech, maintain production; keep defense.
phase_policies.target: Increase air presence and strengthen air forces while continuing to expand and tech up.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Air Transition
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to air without assessing enemy anti-air capabilities.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
